get_config_training: get the default training configuration with architecture, optimizer, and hyperparameters as a ConfigDict
get_conformal_config_coverage: get the default conformal training configuration with alpha, temperature, and loss settings as a ConfigDict
customize_config_architecture: customize the training config to switch between mlp, cnn, or resnet architecture options
customize_config_optimizer: customize the training config to switch between sgd and adam optimizer settings
customize_config_finetune: customize the training config to enable fine-tuning with specific layers and checkpoint paths
